Israeli lobby has given Ted Cruz millions of dollars. He says his top goal in Senate is to serve Israel. And the Israeli lobby just celebrated how much he serves them. And national media says they can't see the bribes or the obvious control. Are these "reporters" dumb or corrupt?

Extreme victim complex combined with an extreme power imbalance is what leads to fascism every time. It happens in different places to different races and religions. But the mindset is always the same - we're the victims, so we get to strike first to "protect ourselves."

The Israelis are absolutely convinced that everyone already hated them - and that they hated them irrationally based on their religion. That's a perfect excuse to do anything you want because it's never your fault. It's the fault of evil antisemites who are being unfair to you.

I have never cared about the Met Gala or the Kennedy Center. These are places for catfights for the elites. 

The main reason why people talk about them so much is because almost everyone in media are part of the elites.

National media is always worried about the erosion of trust in American institutions. They don’t bemoan the actual erosion of those institutions, they bemoan that you noticed that erosion. They don’t blame those institutions, they blame the average American for not trusting them.

I also think they’re anti-intellectual dilettantes and bullies. They hate the idea of open dialogue or anyone challenging the government. And they’re mainly in the business of trying to protect the government and the powerful by attacking their detractors.

I think the people who work at the @nytimes are deeply immoral people who don’t care about Arabs or Muslims at all (or the average American). I think they actively do propaganda that makes it easier for Israel to murder their neighbors. 

What’s most unbearable is that the entire time they pretend to be fighting bigotry. But only against supporters of Israel!! No one else matters. Our lives are not as valuable. 

The so-called reporters at The NY Times are the most biased people in the country.

I thought this was an atrocious interview by Lulu Garcia-Navarro. But it was helpful in exposing mindset of @nytimes. As you can see here, they think that potential harm to beloved Israelis many years from now is a thousand times more important than a genocide of Palestinians.


gato fumante (@KweenInYellow)

Am I crazy or is the New York Times podcast lady actually trying to argue that insulting Jewish people is worse than the mass murder of children?
